---
title: Plan a contribution
---

What to arrange before a dataset is submitted. The submission itself follows
the [Submission manual (clinical)](index.qmd).

## Access

Every submission path uses private BigPicture GitHub repositories, and the
`bp-submission-pipeline` also pulls private container images. Your GitHub
account must be granted access to them before you start. Request it via the
[servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}).

Without access, signing in with GitHub still succeeds, but cloning fails with
"repository not found" or "access denied", and links to the private
repositories show a 404 page.

## Test in staging

BigPicture has two environments: staging for testing, and production for the
archive. Submit a test dataset with a small number of slides to staging first.
Staging is not set up for sensitive personal data.
See [Do a staging run first](bp-submission-pipeline/run-submission.qmd#do-a-staging-run-first).

## Production

Uploading to production requires a signed Terms of Use and separate production credentials from NBIS.
See [Prepare for production](bp-submission-pipeline/prepare-for-production.qmd).
